title: Two Famous Landmarks
text:
The Eiffel Tower is in Paris. It is very tall. Many people visit it every year. You can see the city from the top.

The Great Wall is in China. It is very long and very old. It is a famous wall. People walk on it.

questions.text: Why do many people visit the Eiffel Tower?
options: Because it is a famous and special place
Because it is in their homes

questions.text: What kind of place is the Great Wall?
options: A very long and very old place

vocabulary.definition: high from the bottom to the top
to go to a place to see it
a long, high structure that surrounds or divides an area

paragraph_translations: La Torre Eiffel está en París. Es muy alta. Muchas personas la visitan cada año. Puedes ver la ciudad desde arriba.
La Gran Muralla está en China. Es muy larga y muy antigua. Es una muralla famosa. La gente camina sobre ella.
